limitations: Three source-material patches provide seven long-baseline FIT constraints; spatial support is limited to visible right-side ice, not whole rink.

All rows share their track anchor. Correlation is explicit; repeated targets are not independent anchor measurements.
Exact user target230144256 is HELD; its residual is never a fit/source-selection criterion. Source patch identity alone was reviewed.
Failed or uncertain matches remain archived in excluded_source_candidates; no UV reconstructed from model or hidden endpoints.
